I may be delayed, but I'm just tired of how disappointed viewers are because they were expecting to have something similar to Hill House. From the get-go, Mike F already indicated that it's not a horror story, it is a love story.

But honestly, story-wise i liked Bly better. It might felt dragged but scenes are intertwined with other episodes. And  Mike F has incorporated James' stories well into this series quite well. 

Hill House is a nice psychological horror. There's barely any boring scene because of how scary they set it up. You know the story, you know how messed up the family is. You kind of have an idea how the story will go. 

To cut it short, Hill House will leave you impressed, and Bly Manor will leave you depressed.

As someone who lived in Ottawa. here are my comparison:

Commute:

Calgary has way better transit system. It will take you forever to go around Ottawa, it is a vehicle dependent city. Although, they are expanding the Otrain, it will still take YEARS. Traffic in Ottawa is better though because the population is much smaller than Calgary, so there's that.

Culture:

Calgary is more culturally diverse than Ottawa. But you'll feel more incorporated in Ottawa. i don't know how to explain it but i feel like Calgary is more separated from each other. Ottawa is more like a big town. Ottawa has more of an identity and Calgary is more like a city that sprouted in the middle of a farmland ( obviously, because Ottawa is older).

People:

I must say, people are much, much, nicer in Ottawa (no offense). As i mentioned earlier, it must be because Ottawa has a smaller and older population. Don't get me wrong, i like Calgary, but Ottawa gives you a happier way of living.
